chunks: Sahl, from Bakr ibn Salih, from Malik ibn Ashyam, from one of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) said: 'Marry her (for her) large eyes, brunette (colour), (large) buttocks, medium stature, so if you dislike her, upon me (would be) the dower.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib)

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended physical characteristics for choosing a wife according to Shia hadith, and what is the ruling on dowry if she is disliked?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights Imam Ali’s practical guidance on marital compatibility, emphasizing physical attributes such as height and hair color as valid grounds for a husband's discretion. It establishes a specific legal precedent where the husband bears the financial responsibility (sadaq) if he chooses to exercise his right of rejection based on these criteria, reflecting the Shia scholarly view on the balance between mutual consent and contractual obligations in marriage.
